annotations.snippet: A tough work environment often marks the beginning of the journey to financial independence.
annotations.comment: 开场动机：作者先把投资和财务独立、选择权联系起来，不是先从资产定义讲起。

annotations.snippet: But what if the solution isn’t another job, but greater independence from any job through gradually building passive income?
annotations.comment: 本章主问题之一：投资在这里被定义成逐步摆脱对单一工作的依赖。

annotations.snippet: Risk and return are the pillars of any investment strategy.
annotations.comment: 阅读提示：后面所有资产和策略都要放回“风险-收益”这对支柱里理解。

annotations.snippet: Without a fundamental understanding of what you’re investing in
alt_snippets: Without a fundamental understanding of what you're investing in
risk your capital based on a casual tip from a friend.
annotations.comment: 方法论边界：作者明确反对基于传闻下注，这也是全书转向 data-driven research 的入口。

annotations.snippet: This book aims to guide you toward becoming a data-driven investor.
annotations.comment: 主线提示：这本书的目标不是荐股，而是训练你成为 data-driven investor。

annotations.snippet: Investors should begin by understanding their risk tolerance
annotations.comment: 先记住这句，不必急着背资产定义。作者认为先定义风险承受能力、目标和时间投入。
术语提示：这是债券最值得先记住的直觉定义。

annotations.snippet: describing such assets as extremely low risk would be more accurate
annotations.comment: 边界提醒：所谓 risk-free 往往只是金融惯例，不等于真的没有风险。

annotations.snippet: Savvy investors diversify their risk by not putting all their eggs in one basket.
annotations.comment: ETF 段落的核心入口：先抓“分散化”作用，再看产品细节。

annotations.snippet: The primary value of cryptocurrency lies
annotations.comment: 读 crypto 时先抓用途：作者先解释它解决什么问题，而不是先谈价格故事。

annotations.snippet: Options are powerful tools, but they’re complex instruments with significant risk.
annotations.comment: 风险提示：衍生品不是入门玩具，先记住它们强大但危险。
